laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Party' fits countable plurals; with the mass noun 'goud' a partitive 'n deel' is the natural Afrikaans and keeps the same limited quantity.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Party van die goud' is standard Afrikaans for a portion of a mass noun, so the swap to 'n deel' is lateral.

laat_vaar.voor: 'n Juwelier koop van die suiwer goud en
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'koop van die suiwer goud' can be read as buying from the gold rather than buying some of it; the plain object is clearer and means the same.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Koop van die suiwer goud' is a natural partitive linking back to the refined gold of the previous block; dropping 'van die' loses that link and the 'some of it' sense.

laat_vaar.blok: Waar die wins die opvallendste is
laat_vaar.voor: kan die mynmaatskappye groot winste maak
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: No mining companies were introduced before, so the definite article points to nothing; the general statement reads naturally without it.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: In context 'die mynmaatskappye' reads naturally as the companies owning the mines just discussed, so removing the article is a lateral move that also loosens the reference.

laat_vaar.voor: 'n Plek waar mense klip waarin goud sit, uit die grond haal.
laat_vaar.na: 'n Plek waar mense klip met goud daarin uit die grond haal.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The relative clause nested inside another clause with a comma before the verb is heavy for Grade 6; the phrase 'met goud daarin' says the same more simply.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The definition is grammatical and readable, and 'klip waarin goud sit' deliberately matches the wording of the rif definition and the study text, so rewording it would break that parallel.

vlae.blok: Van die klip tot 'n suiwer staaf; doré-staaf; suiweringswerk
vlae.rede: Attributive 'ru' before a noun is usually inflected ('ruwe goud', as in 'ruwe olie'), but the form appears three times, twice in glossary definitions that may be shared, so it should be changed consistently or not at all; left for the reviewer or writer.

laat_vaar_vorige.na: en die werk in die myn laat doen
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'sy' could refer to the business or the mine; naming the mine's work removes the ambiguity without changing the meaning.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'sy' naturally points to the mine and either reading means the same, while 'in die myn' narrows the work to underground and rewords a shared glossary definition.
